[[Sehlon's Vow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Sehlon, Beautiful Water]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Bahdok Caverns]].

==Stats==
:[[Fire damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Suntouched Scythe]] [[dye|dyed]] black.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Chinwe]] or [[Roland le Moisson]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
*[[Fiery]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Hlengiwe]] or [[Hermehinu]] or crafters [[Bolereh]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Fiery]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
AND
*Black [[dye]]
